concept: Kiss the Sky spins a vinyl-shop neon palette: a bold electric-purple primary lit by a hot-magenta secondary and a vivid neon-cyan accent, grounded by inky charcoal-violet text on warm paper-white backgrounds. Music-forward, energetic, and a little retro -- like a backlit record sleeve glowing in a darkened listening room.
contrastNotes: All required ratios verified against #FAF6F0 bg (L=0.925). ink #1A1622 on bg = 16.5:1 (>=7). ink-soft #5C5466 on bg = 6.7:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #8E1CC9 = 6.6:1 (>=4.5); white on primary-dark #6E12A0 = 9.3:1. primary #8E1CC9 on bg = 6.2:1 (>=3). Bonus: white on secondary #D8208E = 4.6:1 (AA for UI text). Accent #16D9D9 is a bright neon-cyan reserved for decorative highlights and for use on the dark ink fields (accent on ink = ~9:1), not for body text on the light bg.
